title: Soil Volume Calculator: Cubic Yards, Honestly
description: Calculate soil, compost or topsoil volume for an area and depth with the Soil Volume Calculator — cubic feet and cubic yards for ordering. Free.
summary_sentence: For example, an 8 × 4 ft raised bed filled 12 inches deep needs 32 cubic feet of soil — 1.19 cubic yards, or about 21 standard 1.5-cubic-foot bags, which is the number the garden centre actually sells by.
quick_answer: The Soil Volume Calculator works out how much soil, compost or topsoil an area needs at a chosen depth — area times depth, reported in cubic feet and cubic yards. Enter the area and the depth and read the order quantity for raised beds, lawn top-dressing and landscape renovation.
